found.truth_sql: SELECT o.id AS c0, u.state AS c1, u.city AS c2, o.user_id AS c3 FROM shop.orders o LEFT JOIN shop.users u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop.products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE (NOT (nullIf(toString(o.status), 'completed') IN ('cancelled'))) ORDER BY c0 ASC LIMIT 1 SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
